description:
This file defines the LU decomposition class for matrices within the Matrix\Decomposition
amespace. It provides methods for obtaining the lower and upper triangular matrices, pivot matrices, and solving linear systems using LU decomposition.

classes.name: LU
classes.description: Class representing the LU matrix decomposition for a given matrix, including pivoting and solution methods.

methods.name: getL
methods.description: Returns the lower triangular matrix from the LU decomposition.

methods.name: getU
methods.description: Returns the upper triangular matrix from the LU decomposition.

methods.name: getP
methods.description: Returns the permutation matrix representing pivoting.

methods.name: getPivot
methods.description: Returns the pivot vector indicating row exchanges.

methods.name: isNonsingular
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is nonsingular based on the LU decomposition.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the linear system A*X = B using LU decomposition.
